hero.tagline: I design products people use, then I build them.
hero.description: **4 years** of full-cycle product work: research, Figma, production code. I bridge both sides: what users need and what the business must achieve. **10+ live launches** across SaaS, fintech, and web for **10+ international clients**.

about.title: Design built to survive the handoff.
about.body: Details often get lost between Figma and code. I design in Figma and build in React, Vue, and Tailwind, so the screens that ship match the screens that were approved.
about.designerBody: Research first, then wireframes, systems, and high-fidelity screens that hold up under real use.
about.engineerBody: I write React, Vue, and Tailwind well enough to hand off clean specs or build the front end myself.
about.systemsTitle: Design systems from the first frame
about.aiTitle: Figma to code, with AI in the loop
about.codeTitle: Production code, built from the design
about.stackTitle: One stack, from design to deploy
about.prdTitle: Brief to PRD, every requirement mapped

prd.brief: Charities need to see <r1>funds raised across currencies</r1>, organise <r2>hundreds of campaigns</r2>, and run <r3>group bookings without missing details</r3>.

experience.title: Four years, hands-on the whole way.
experience.lead: Contract work on government and enterprise dashboards, plus freelance product design for international clients, with Top Rated status on Upwork.

process.title: From research to release.
process.lead: I handle all four steps myself, from the first user interview to production code. Scroll through to see what I deliver at each one.
process.scrollHint: Scroll to walk through the process

steps.label: Discover
steps.title: Research
steps.body: I start with the user's problem and the business goal, so every design decision has a reason behind it.
steps.ai: Sorting interview notes into themes takes minutes instead of days.

steps.label: Define
steps.title: PRD & flows
steps.body: Read the brief or PRD, map every requirement to a screen and its states, and agree on scope before any pixels.
steps.ai: Audit PRD coverage so no requirement slips through.

steps.label: Design
steps.title: Design
steps.body: I wireframe the flow, build the design system, and turn it into a hi-fi Figma prototype for review.
steps.ai: Explore more layout options early, then refine the chosen one by hand.

steps.label: Deliver
steps.title: Build & ship
steps.body: I build the front end myself in responsive, accessible Vue or React, so the release matches the approved design.
steps.ai: AI-assisted coding speeds up the build, and I review every line before it ships.
